args.title: Prevent merging of rows with differing currencies in CSV export
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The CSV writer currently merges rows that share the same date, amount, and description, which causes rows with different currencies to be combined into a single row. This results in the loss of transaction data when exporting. The fix should ensure that rows with differing currencies are treated as distinct and exported separately, preserving all transaction details.
